digest.component_or_area: outbound link emission and mutation building
propositions: Config-driven link-relation mapping must preserve skip semantics: a forced skip neither adds nor removes links, never substituting approximate alternatives.

The same effective link_map must govern both ADD (_diff_links) and REMOVE (_diff_link_removals) paths via a unified _resolve_link resolver that composes config override link_type with built-in swap preservation.

REMOVE attribution must be config-aware: when a remote link carries an overridden vendor type, it must be recovered via inverted link_map before being dropped or retained, preventing spurious adoption of remapped links.
Undeclared link types must fail-closed: any link_map value outside a declared link_types vocabulary raises MappingConfigError during effective_link_map validation.
ADD and REMOVE must emit the same overridden vendor type: override replaces only the link_type while preserving built-in swap logic, ensuring bidirectional consistency without re-substitution.
